notes.title: 1.0.1 - Small fixes update
notes.notes:
- Fixed leaderboards not showing unless you already had a score.
- Slightly decreased the hitbox on the bookshelves so you cant rub the books on the side of the case and have it register.
- Fixed some tooltip text.
- Should stutter a bit less on first load.

notes.title: LET ME BOOK is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Let Me Book is finally available on Steam!

Let Me Book started out as a game jam idea that quickly progressed into a simple, tight, hilariously-scary challenge. It scored #9 for [u]Horror[/u] and #12 overall in [b]Scream Jam 2024[/b] out of over 500 entries, which I couldn't be more proud of! 

Since the demo - I've added a level map, leaderboards, a secret ending and so much more!
(Also I made it significantly harder as a tradeoff for the map)

Hope you guys enjoy playing it as much as I did making it!
